title.narrative: Accelerating the AIDS response through a resilient and sustainable health system in order to achieve the 90-90-90 targets - Chad (01-Apr-2019-31-Dec-2021)

description.narrative: Chad, HIV, Ministry of Public Health (MOH)This program has the following goals: HIV: Reduce new HIV infections in the general population, key and vulnerable populations from 4,800 in 2016 to 3,397 in 2022. HIV: Reduce new pediatric HIV infections from 21% in 2016 to 5% by 2022. HIV: Reduce the number of deaths linked to HIV from 2,800 in 2016 to under 1,000 by 2022. HIV: Alleviate the psychological, social, economic and legal situation regarding HIV for PLHIV, OVC and other affected persons during the period 2018-2022. RSSH: Secure universal access for the population to quality, global, integrated and continuous healthcare centred on the person with a view to making an effective contribution to the socio-economic development of the country.. The objectives of this program are: HIV: 90% of adult and youth PLHIV to benefit from quality medical treatment by 2022. HIV: 90% of PLHIV undergoing ART to survive in the HIV care cascade 12 months after start of antiretroviral treatment by 2022. HIV: Vertical transmission of HIV from mother to child to be reduced from 14% to less than 5% by 2022. HIV: At least 95% of key populations and 80% of vulnerable populations to adopt lower-risk behaviour by 2022. HIV: 70% of PLHIV to enjoy human rights and gender and equity balance. HIV: Reinforce capacities of actors in view of better governance and performance of health and community systems. RSSH: Reinforcer the national health information system (gradual implementation of DHIS2) and the monitoring and follow-up/assessment system for activities to inform appropriate decisions to meet the challenges of public health growth in Chad. RSSH: Maternal, neonatal and infant mortality linked to HIV to be reduced by 50% by 2022

Percentage of health facilities with essential medicines and life-saving commodities in stock
Percentage of people living with HIV newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy
Percentage of people living with HIV initiated on ART who are screened for TB in HIV treatment settings
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) reached with HIV prevention programs- defined package of services
KP-3a - other 2: number and percentage of 'populations at risk' who have had an HIV test and know their result
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART, who have a suppressed viral load at 12 months (<1000 copies/ml)
KP-1a - other 1: percentage of 'populations at risk' having benefited from HIV prevention programs (defined service package)
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Number of adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) who were tested for HIV and received their results during the reporting period
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

Percentage of births attended by skilled health professional
Percentage of (estimated) people living with HIV who have been tested HIV-positive
